derivation.method: Authored from the pinned Steel Compendium only (canonical checkout at the main repo vendor/steel-compendium, HEAD fb83a789 verified with git rev-parse). Level-one baselines copied from tests/fixtures/v102-troubadour-expected.json (reviewed) and cross-checked by recomputation. No evaluator, content, convex or headless code read or run.
derivation.staminaMaximum: Troubadour Basics: Starting Stamina 18 + 6 per level after 1st; kit Stamina bonus per echelon (chapter/kits.md); levels 1-3 are echelon 1 (rule/general/echelon.md "1st Echelon (1st to 3rd Level)"). Kit Stamina: Swashbuckler +3, Cloak and Dagger +3, Sniper none, Panther +6 - consistent with v102 level-one values 21/21/18/24.
derivation.noNumericSheetChange: EXPLICIT: no level-2 or level-3 Troubadour feature (Appeal to the Muses; Invocation and its options Allow Me to Introduce Tonight's Players, Formal Introductions, My Reputation Precedes Me; Perk; 2nd-Level Class Act Ability; 3rd-Level Class Act Feature and Missed Cue, Foil, Second Album; 7-Drama Ability), no class act ability, no 7-drama ability, no Second Album performance and none of the selected perks changes any numeric sheet value (recoveries, speed, stability, disengage, characteristics, potency, size). The only numeric changes are Stamina maximum (+6 per level) and the recovery/winded values derived from it. My Reputation Precedes Me's +2 Renown is situational (negotiation entry with the bonded NPC only), not a sheet value. Characteristic Increase first appears at 4th level; kit Stamina scales only at echelon 2 (level 4).
derivation.abilityCounts: Advancement table: level 2 adds one 5-drama class act ability (Class Act Abilities 5); level 3 adds one 7-drama ability (Abilities Signature, 3, 5, 7). Virtuoso additionally gains two Second Album performances at level 3.
derivation.abilityDamage: "X + A" / "X + P" add the Agility / Presence score (all witnesses A2, P2). Kit damage bonus added only for damage-dealing abilities with Melee+Weapon (melee bonus) or Ranged+Weapon (ranged bonus), once (chapter/kits.md Damage Bonuses); an ability with both Melee and Ranged gets only the bonus of the chosen mode (rule/combat/distance.md Melee or Ranged). Star Solo primary mode: melee.
derivation.potency: Troubadour potency weak P-2 / average P-1 / strong P = 0/1/2 with Presence 2 (class/troubadour.md Basics).
derivation.perkChoice: One distinct eligible perk per witness, covering all three permitted groups; none with sub-choices, none granting an ability, none already owned (all bases own only Teamwork, an exploration perk).

uncertainties.resolution: Grouping from en/books/heroes/clean/Draw Steel Heroes.md: Auteur 15611 (Guest Star 15615, Twist at the End 15625); Duelist 15635 (Classic Chandelier Stunt 15639, En Garde! 15649); Virtuoso 15665 (Encore 15669, Tough Crowd 15679). Unified ability front-matter subclass agrees.

uncertainties.passage: 3rd-Level Class Act Features Table lists Duelist "Foil" without a link (unified and book line 15708).
uncertainties.resolution: en/unified/md/feature/troubadour/level-3/foil.md (subclass: duelist) is the feature; book prints it at line 15711.

uncertainties.passage: we-meet-at-last.md front-matter effects list has only the first paragraph; the markdown body and book line 15805 add "Additionally, once on each of your turns, you can use a free maneuver ... granting them 2 surges or forcing them to take a bane on the next ability roll ..."
uncertainties.resolution: Both paragraphs are the ability text (book is authoritative print); an importer reading only front-matter effects would drop the free-maneuver clause.
alternatives: front-matter only (would lose the free maneuver - rejected)

uncertainties.passage: star-solo.md keywords Magic, Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon; distance "Melee 1 or ranged 10". rule/combat/distance.md Melee or Ranged: "you choose whether to use it as a melee or a ranged ability ... only one bonus at a time applies to an ability with both the Melee and Ranged keywords."
uncertainties.resolution: Melee mode applies only the kit melee damage bonus (primary expected value); ranged mode only the ranged bonus and ranged distance bonus. Both modes recorded.
alternatives: stack melee and ranged bonuses (explicitly forbidden by distance.md)

uncertainties.passage: infernal-gavotte.md keywords Area, Magic, Melee, Weapon; chapter/kits.md: melee damage bonus "is added to the rolled damage of any damage-dealing ability with both the Melee and Weapon keywords."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION (keyword-literal): the kit melee damage bonus applies to this area ability (Cloak and Dagger +1/+1/+1 -> [6, 8, 11]); Sniper has no melee bonus -> [5, 7, 10]. The kit distance bonus does not enlarge the 3 burst (chapter/kits.md Distance Bonus).
alternatives: kit damage bonuses apply only to strikes/non-area weapon abilities (would give [5, 7, 10] for v102-2-alt) - not supported by the text

uncertainties.passage: classic-chandelier-stunt.md: "Each target can then make a melee free strike that deals extra damage equal to twice their highest characteristic score."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: the extra damage (2 x 2 = 4 for v102-2-alt) is added once to every tier of the melee weapon free strike, which also keeps its kit melee bonus: [2,5,7] + A2 + 1 + 4 = [9, 12, 14]. The ally's free strike uses the ally's own characteristics (manual).
alternatives: extra damage excluded from kit bonus interplay (same numbers; bonus is additive)
free strike is a separate ability and the Chandelier row should record only the +4 rider

uncertainties.passage: encore.md: "You use an ability that you have observed being used this combat round ... you use your Presence score for any power rolls, and any damage you deal is sonic damage."
uncertainties.resolution: Not resolved; kept manual. No damageByWitness for Encore. Unclear whether the copied ability's characteristic bonus in tier text (e.g. "+ M") becomes Presence, and whether the troubadour's kit damage bonus applies to a copied Weapon ability.
alternatives: Presence replaces the power-roll characteristic and every characteristic reference in the damage expression
Presence replaces only the roll bonus; tier-text characteristic stays as printed but uses the troubadour's own score
kit bonus applies per the copied ability's Melee/Ranged+Weapon keywords
kit bonus never applies (Encore has no Weapon keyword)

uncertainties.passage: tough-crowd.md: "At the end of each of your turns, you can make one power roll that targets each enemy in the area."
uncertainties.resolution: INTERPRETATION: using the ability (main action) creates the haunted area; the printed power roll is made at the end of each of your turns (including the turn you used it), not as part of the main action itself. Damage [5, 9, 12] corruption, no kit bonus.
alternatives: the roll is also made immediately when the ability is used
the first roll waits until the end of your next turn

uncertainties.passage: guest-star.md: "Their Stamina maximum is half yours."
uncertainties.resolution: Half your Stamina maximum rounded down (rule/general/always-round-down.md): v102-1 13 at level 2, 16 at level 3.
alternatives: half your current Stamina (the text says Stamina maximum; rejected)

uncertainties.passage: Second Album performances printed with quotation marks: book lines 15723 and 15733; unified front-matter name '"Fire Up the Night"' and '"Never-Ending Hero"'.
uncertainties.resolution: Names recorded including the double quotation marks, matching the v102 convention for "Ballad of the Beast" / "Thunder Mother".
alternatives: unquoted names Fire Up the Night / Never-Ending Hero

uncertainties.passage: 3rd-Level Class Act Feature grants one feature; Second Album itself grants two abilities.
uncertainties.resolution: Virtuoso level-3 addedFeatures lists both "3rd-Level Class Act Feature" and "Second Album" (same pattern for Missed Cue / Foil), mirroring v117 which lists both the container feature and the granted feature.
alternatives: list only the granted feature name

Guest Star.name: Guest Star
effectsPlain: Effect: A guest star appears to help you during the encounter: either a bystander within distance uplifted by your magic, or a mysterious new hero who appears in an unoccupied space within distance. This guest star is controlled by you, has their own turn, and shares your characteristics. Their Stamina maximum is half yours. They have no abilities other than your melee and ranged free strikes. At the end of the encounter, or when the guest star is reduced to 0 Stamina, they retreat or revert to a bystander. The same bystander can't be uplifted this way more than once during an encounter.
Guest Star.kitDamageBonusReason: No power roll and no Weapon keyword (Magic, Ranged).

guestStarStaminaMaximumByWitness.formula: floor(27 / 2) = 13 ("Their Stamina maximum is half yours"; rule/general/always-round-down.md)

manualClauses: Guest star appears (uplifted bystander within distance, or new hero in an unoccupied space within distance); controlled by you with its own turn; shares your characteristics.
Guest star has no abilities other than your melee and ranged free strikes.
Guest star retreats or reverts at the end of the encounter or at 0 Stamina; the same bystander can't be uplifted more than once per encounter.

Twist at the End.name: Twist at the End
effectsPlain: Effect: A target who is not a leader or solo creature comes back to life with half their Stamina and becomes an ally under the Director's control. The players can work with the Director to determine when the target takes their turn each combat round. At the end of the encounter, the target turns to dust and is blown away.
Twist at the End.kitDamageBonusReason: No power roll and no Weapon keyword (Magic, Ranged).
manualClauses: Target (one dead enemy, not a leader or solo creature) returns to life with half its Stamina and becomes an ally under the Director's control.
